body: Stray Kids’ This & That puts K-pop back in a familiar spot — No. 1 on the all-genre Billboard 200 chart. Stray Kids  has amassed nine No. 1 titles on the Billboard 200, which puts them out front among K-pop acts.  BTS is second, with seven No. 1 titles.  ATEEZ  is next in line with three No. 1s.  SuperM ,  BLACKPINK ,  TOMORROW X TOGETHER ,  NewJeans  and  TWICE  have all notched one No. 1 to date. In addition, one multi-artist K-pop soundtrack, KPop Demon Hunters , has reached No. 1. For all their success on the Billboard 200, Stray Kids have yet to crack the top 40 on the Billboard Hot 100. Their highest-charting single on that chart, “Chk Chk Boom,” debuted and peaked at No. 49 in August 2024.
